entropy_separation_proxy.standardization: per-row z-score on subsampled channels and sources
entropy_separation_proxy.note: scale-free entropy diff in nats; NOT a true MIR (no |det W| term).

mir.standardization: per-row z-score on subsampled channels and sources

complete_mir.note: subspace MIR (Frank 2022 eq. 5) computed in retained PCA-whitened space.
complete_mir.definition: Frank 2022 eq. (5): Σh(X_pca_i) - Σh(Y_i) + log2|det W|
complete_mir.estimator: 100-bin histogram, ±5 sd clip, no z-score (raw amplitudes in retained-rank space)

pmi.estimator: 32-bin 2D histogram on per-row z-scored channels/sources clipped to +-5 sd
pmi.note: Lower remnant_PMI_percent = better; sensitive to histogram bias at small n_samples_used.

dipolarity.method: mne.fit_dipole with Frank 2022 4-shell sphere (r=71/72/79/85 mm, σ=0.33/0.0042/1/0.33)
